description: Probe-only evidence for ASM_SDPA_ENGINE (forward) on a padded leading stride, crossed with the declared alignment. bfloat16 SDPA forward in the engine's region (head size 128 or 192 for Q and K, 128 for V and O, BSHD or BHSD, grouped-query heads, dense, no stats) over a small shape set, where the row stride of the tensors `pad_on` names (q, k, v, o, or all four) is the packed one plus `pad`; the row stride is the stride between two consecutive sequence positions, in elements. BHSD: the row stride is the head size plus pad, and the head and batch strides grow with it. BSHD: the row stride is heads * head size plus pad and the head stride stays the head size, so a head's vector stays contiguous and only the rows are spread apart, the way a slice of a larger activation looks. The `pad` elements after a row are gap elements that belong to no element. `pad` takes 0 (packed), 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 (below or off a 16-byte vector of 8 bfloat16), 8, 16 and 24 (16-byte multiples), and 9, 15, 17 and 31 (break the vector width). It is crossed with the declared alignment of Q, K, V and O (tensor_patches on uids 1, 0, 3, 2) and with the placement of the device pointers, as in Matmul/Align and SdpaFwd/Flash2: exact puts every device pointer at exactly the declared alignment, under misaligns Q below it (a PASS then means the backend rejected the pointer), default leaves the pointers where they are; under drawn at alignment 1 is rendered as exact. It exists to show whether the engine, whose kernels issue 16-byte row loads and stores, computes the right output, or declines, when a row stride is not a 16-byte multiple. Expected (probed on gfx950, 48 samples and every pair): PASS at every pad, odd ones included, when the declared alignment is at least 16 (the kernel takes any row stride), DECLINED when the declared alignment is below 16 whatever the pad. WRONG or CRASH on a padded stride is the finding. Only strides, alignment and placement vary: the input fill stays at its default range. pad_on has no effect at pad 0, so every pad_on but 'all' is illegal there.

derive.stride_q: [sq*row_q, dqk, row_q, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*row_q, sq*row_q, row_q, 1]
derive.stride_k: [skv*row_k, dqk, row_k, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*row_k, skv*row_k, row_k, 1]
derive.stride_v: [skv*row_v, dv, row_v, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*row_v, skv*row_v, row_v, 1]
derive.stride_o: [sq*row_o, dv, row_o, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*row_o, sq*row_o, row_o, 1]
derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement

constraints.reason: pad_on names no tensor when pad is 0: every pad_on would render the same packed graph
